_comment: Generated by scripts/build_patch_data.py from the cached EA page in data/patch-source/. 'text' is EA's exact wording and must stay that way - scripts/build_patch_data.py --check re-reads EA's page and fails if any bullet is missing or altered. 'section' and 'items' are meant to be hand-corrected and are not overwritten by --check.

entries.text: Vehicle Combat and Mobile Anti-Air Tuning: Anti-Air receives a broad balance pass across several major areas, alongside further updates to tank damage angles, regeneration, vehicle weapons, rockets, and Anti-Vehicle Mines.
heading: Major Updates for 2.1.1.0

entries.text: Player Combat and Animation Polish: Soldier presentation has been improved across death animations, swimming, revives, hit reactions, and vehicle seating, while recoil compensation, reload behaviour, weapon attachments, and optic presentation have received further updates.
heading: Major Updates for 2.1.1.0

entries.text: UI, HUD and Spectator Mode Clarity: In-game information and menu presentation have been improved across Spectator Mode, the Deploy Screen, Loadouts, Customisation, reconnection messaging, player status information, thumbnails, and front-end navigation.
heading: Major Updates for 2.1.1.0

entries.text: Portal Creator and Custom Lobby Updates: Portal creators receive new Verified Portal Modes, Custom Maps, SDK functions, water controls, notification tools, and updated example levels, alongside improvements to hosting, team setup, player management, lobby transitions, and Custom Experience presentation.
heading: Major Updates for 2.1.1.0

entries.text: Audio, AI and Stability Improvements: Audio feedback has been improved across vehicles, weapons, voice-over, controllers, maps, and underwater gameplay, while AI navigation and behaviour, Campaign access, lighting, and visual-effect stability have also received further polish.
heading: Major Updates for 2.1.1.0

entries.text: REDSEC and Ranked Battle Royale Updates: Rapid Royale arrives alongside a new Ranked Battle Royale season, while class equipment, Field Training, redeploy loadouts, armour plating, mission flow, loot presentation, Second Chance behaviour, and Ranked End of Round information have been updated.
heading: Major Updates for 2.1.1.0
